items.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
items.description: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar explains how advances across chips, compute, models, and products compound to deliver more useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost.

items.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
items.description: Jalapeño is a custom inference chip from OpenAI that delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models.

items.title: Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia
items.description: OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a “sovereignty” index praising Russia and criticizing the West.

items.title: Introducing the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex
items.description: Use the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex to analyze workspace usage, manage members and permissions, adjust limits, and act on admin requests.

items.title: Advancing price-performance for developers with GPT‑5.6 in Kiro
items.description: GPT‑5.6 is now available in Kiro, helping developers plan, build, review, and test software with better price-performance.

items.title: Introducing AI Futures
items.description: Introducing AI Futures, a new OpenAI blog exploring how transformative AI could reshape power, governance, the economy, and individual freedom.

items.title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
items.description: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.

items.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
items.description: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

items.title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
items.description: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, so anyone can turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads expands across Europe
items.description: ChatGPT Ads is expanding to 31 European markets. Learn how advertisers can reach people as they explore, compare options, and make decisions.

items.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
items.description: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.

items.title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
items.description: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly.

items.title: Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities
items.description: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models. See how new safeguards are guiding the pace of model development.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections
items.description: ChatGPT for Teens helps teens learn, think critically, and use AI with confidence, with stronger built-in protections, healthy-use features, and additional controls for parents.

items.title: How NVIDIA scales expertise with ChatGPT Work
items.description: NVIDIA teams use ChatGPT Work to reduce manual tasks, connect fast-moving signals, and scale successful workflows globally.
